scope: Recover Cast HTTP reads from an SFTP provider after a pooled SSH session has gone stale.

evidence.receiver: Receiver entered IDLE with error reason after requesting the stream.
evidence.http: Cast server received GET for an SFTP-hosted MP3 and resolved audio/mpeg with a known length.
evidence.failure: SftpBlockDevice failed during opening-channel after JSch reported 'session is down'; local playback worked again after Cast disconnected.

change.rangeChannel: On a known dead-session error, replace the pooled SFTP session and retry opening the independent range channel once.
change.metadataChannel: When a metadata operation detects a dead session, evict that pooled client so later operations establish a fresh session. The failed callback is not replayed.
change.failurePolicy: A failed reconnect or retry remains an explicit source read error.

acceptancePending: Retry the same SFTP-hosted MP3 and inspect sftp.session.reconnect and cast.http.complete in the next diagnostic dump.
